notes: tech.walmart.com's Global Tech careers page sends 'India based' searches to the Walmart Workday tenant 'walmart' / site 'WalmartExternal' with the India country facet c4f78be1a8f14da0ab49ce1162348a5e. CXS POST body: appliedFacets + searchText + limit/offset (20 rows per page, 194 postings at capture). Facets published: timeType, jobFamilyGroup, jobFamily, Job_Profiles, company, distance and the nested locationMainGroup. No sort parameter is accepted by the CXS body, so the adapter keeps the portal's default (most-recent-first) order.
